conditions: The protected expression has produced an exception packet and the handler match has returned FAIL.
limitations: The claim does not cover a successful match, an exception raised while evaluating a selected handler body, or any compiler stack representation.

triggers: Publisher revision, byte drift, a source correction, contrary technical evidence, or a material scope correction.

statement: In the revised Standard ML dynamic semantics, if the expression protected by a handler evaluates to an exception packet and the handler match fails, the handler expression evaluates to the same exception packet.
